questions.text: C 为单位圆的逆时针正向边界，则闭曲线积分 ∮C (−y dx+x dy) 为？

questions.subject: 数学
questions.text: 已知需求价格 p(q)=20−q，总成本 C(q)=4q+9，q≥0。利润最大的产量是？
questions.explanation: 利润为 q(20−q)−(4q+9)=16q−q²−9。导数 16−2q=0 得 q=8，二阶导数 −2<0，且边界不优于该点。

questions.point: 经济应用：连续收入现值
questions.text: 某项目未来 2 年每年连续产生收入 100 单位，连续贴现率为 r=0.05。收入现值是哪一式？
questions.explanation: 时刻 t 的收入流折为 100e^(−0.05t)，现值是 ∫₀²100e^(−0.05t)dt=2000(1−e^(−0.1))，不能全部按期末一次贴现。

questions.text: Read: A town offered free bus rides for one month. Car traffic fell near the station, yet no counts were taken elsewhere. What can reasonably be concluded?
options: The policy permanently changed travel habits.
A local decline was observed, but town-wide effects are uncertain.
Free buses had no effect anywhere.

questions.point: 英语阅读：让步与论证边界
questions.text: Read: Although automated summaries can spare readers routine work, their apparent fluency may conceal omissions. Their value therefore depends less on replacing judgment than on helping readers decide where closer reading is warranted. What is the author’s position?

questions.point: 英语长难句：嵌套条件与否定
questions.text: “The claim that a method is reliable merely because it has often been used is one that the researchers would accept only if independent tests supported it.” Which paraphrase is accurate?

questions.text: Choose the best translation of “Access to data does not necessarily lead to a better decision.”

questions.text: Choose the best translation of “However convincing a forecast may appear, it remains conditional on assumptions that can change.”

无论预测看起来多么有说服力，它仍以可能变化的假设为条件。

questions.text: 两个社区人口结构和公共设施不同，采用同一种服务安排效果差异很大。改进时最合适的方法是？
options: 忽视差异，坚持同一安排
只参考其中一次偶然反馈
结合各社区具体条件分析矛盾并调整方案

questions.text: 某地产业结构改变后，职业观念逐渐调整，但部分旧观念仍持续存在。最恰当的解释是？

questions.text: 调查发现参加学习小组的人平均成绩较高，但没有随机分组。最稳妥的表述是？
